name: Calendar Desk
description: Keeps what has a date — your calendar, the notes you leave on meetings, and reminders you ask for or your agents find — and acts at the right moment: a to-do on the morning it is due, a message at the minute, a prep note before a meeting.
_comment: Runs OUT OF PROCESS like Slack Desk, on @flock/app-sdk (platform-supplied into node_modules). Two clocks: the platform's hourly app-relay tick does the heavy, lease-taking work (scrape, ingest, publish today's rows); the app's own 1-minute loop fires timed reminders and the meeting-prep window from the local store. TODO rows are platform-owned: this app only publishes and withdraws them by source ref (spec D4/D5).

agent.label: Agent that reminds you and prepares you for meetings

intents.name: reminder_due
intents.description: A timed reminder's minute has arrived. Tell the user in one or two lines.

intents.name: meeting_prep
intents.description: A meeting starts within the prep window. Write a short prep note.

operations.name: add_reminder
operations.description: Store a reminder: {title, dueDate:'YYYY-MM-DD', dueTime?:'HH:MM', body?, recurrence?:'yearly'}. Resolve relative dates yourself first.

operations.name: cancel_reminder
operations.description: Cancel a reminder by id or by {match:'words from its title'}.

operations.name: snooze_reminder
operations.description: Move a reminder to another day: {id? | match?, untilDate:'YYYY-MM-DD'}. Works for a reminder already on the to-do list too.

operations.name: refresh_calendar
operations.description: Re-read Google Calendar now: {force?: true to ignore the 2-hour freshness window}. Daily cap still applies.

operations.name: list_upcoming
operations.description: Reminders and calendar events in the next {days:14} days.

operations.name: set_event_note
operations.description: Attach what you should do before a meeting: {match:{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', titleContains:'…'}, note}. Returns AMBIGUOUS with candidates when several match.

agentInterface.instructions: When the user asks to be reminded, call add_reminder and confirm the date (and time, if any) you understood in one line. 'Push it to Monday' / 'remind me later' on a reminder is snooze_reminder. 'What's coming up' or 'what reminders do I have' is list_upcoming — answer from it, never by opening the calendar. A note about what to do before a meeting is set_event_note. When you receive a reminder_due intent: say the reminder in one or two lines in this chat, include the source link if there is one, and end with the waiting-on-user block. When you receive meeting_prep: write a prep note within the budget given (who is attending and what memory says about them, the user's note verbatim, open threads with those people from the last 14 days); if memory has nothing, say so in one line rather than nothing; end with the waiting-on-user block.

routines.name: Add today's reminders to your list
routines.description: Each morning, puts the reminders due today on your to-do list — the ones you asked for and the dates your agents found in email and Slack. Reminders with a time of day are sent as a message at that minute instead.
routines._cronComment: HOURLY DISPATCH, DAILY WORK — the tick publishes once the local hour reaches publishHour and leaves the day unclaimed if the platform refused, so a later tick finishes it. A reminder created later the same day is published on the next tick (Review Focus 1).

configSchema.label: Also remind me about dates my agents find in email and Slack
Days before a birthday or anniversary

routines.name: Prepare me before meetings
routines.description: Shortly before a meeting, your assistant sends a short prep note: who is coming, what you said you wanted to raise, and what memory knows about them.
routines._cronComment: The owner-visible cadence. The app's own loop evaluates the window every minute; this routine's enabled flag and config are what the loop reads.
